# Vendored graph renderer

`3d-force-graph-1.80.0.min.js` is the pinned browser bundle of
[`3d-force-graph`](https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph), version
1.80.0. It is distributed under the MIT license; the corresponding license is
kept in `3d-force-graph-LICENSE.txt`.

The NCS graph page serves this local file directly. It does not load a CDN or
send NCS graph data to an external service.
